vellum_obligation: A shape-chart shader draw must pad its draw rect by the declared reach and refuse a glow/outer feather whose reach is under 3 sigma; chart coordinates must be available for the flat arc, segments, stadium and ring. Concretely: PulpChart is derived for flat_arc, ring, flat_segment, rounded_segment and stadium with t along the centre line, cross the signed offset along (tan.y, -tan.x) and halfWidth; d includes flat caps on the flat arc and flat segment; rounded caps are domes about their end point; quadratic_bezier stays refused; and a chart feather scales the premultiplied colour, not alpha alone.
evidence: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart feather keeps the colour premultiplied'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart refuses and names every shape it cannot chart'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: degenerate bands report valid = 0'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: ring and flat arc chart t around and cross radially'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: segments and stadium chart t along and cross across'
